lines.label: B1
lines.reason: Base plate (outer skin p1) to flange 3/4 (outer skin p4), about 90 deg formed fold along the long edge. The perpendicular sections at 25/50/75% (sec_B1.png, seczoom_B1.png) put the label exactly on the outer-skin apex of the rounded fold. I sampled the apex at 72 stations along the line with no gaps: the outermost point along the bisector is median -0.014 mm from the line (p5..p95 -0.039..+0.004 mm). The line is parallel to the fold. It spans t 0..288.3 mm, and the fold zone spans t -0.9..289.2 mm, so it covers about 99% of the visible fold. Both ends stop at the part's end faces (closeup_B1.png).

lines.label: B2
lines.reason: Base plate (outer skin p1) to flange 5/6 (outer skin p6), about 90 deg formed fold along the opposite long edge. The sections at 25/50/75% (sec_B2.png, seczoom_B2.png) put the label on the outer-skin apex. Across 72 stations with no gaps, the outermost point along the bisector is median -0.019 mm from the line (p5..p95 -0.035..+0.022 mm). The line is parallel to the fold. It spans t 0..288.3 mm against a fold zone of t -0.97..289.2 mm, so it covers about 99%.
